mapper.sql: USER_ID AS userId, LOGIN_ID AS loginId, PASSWORD_HASH AS passwordHash, NICKNAME AS nickname, NAME_ENC AS nameEnc, PHONE_ENC AS phoneEnc, PHONE_HMAC AS phoneHmac, EMAIL_ENC AS emailEnc, EMAIL_HMAC AS emailHmac, BIRTH_YEAR AS birthYear, WORKER_TYPE_CODE AS workerTypeCode, ROLE_CODE AS roleCode, ACCOUNT_STATUS_CODE AS accountStatusCode, LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT AS loginFailCount, CREATED_AT AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM APP_USER WHERE PHONE_HMAC = #{phoneHmac} AND ROLE_CODE = 'ROLE_USER' AND ACCOUNT_STATUS_CODE <> 'WITHDRAWN' ORDER BY USER_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APP_USER WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APP_USER WHERE EMAIL_HMAC = #{emailHmac}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APP_USER WHERE NICKNAME = #{nickname}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSESSMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND GRADE_STATUS_CODE = 'SCORED'
